<!--
A cruise report is a METADATA report. It documents how the data were collected, describes
the survey, and shows enough of the catch to make the data interpretable. It is not an
analysis of those data — that belongs in a data report or a manuscript.
-->

```{r setup}
#| include: false
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
source(here::here("R", "0_setup.R"))
source(here::here("R", "report_helpers.R"))
```

```{r snapshots}
#| include: false
#| eval: false
# Load one local snapshot per data component, each with an empty-shape fallback so that the
# document always renders even when a component has not been collected yet. R/1_data.R
# fetches from the vessel's servers and writes these; this document never reads the server.
read_snapshot <- function(name, empty = tibble::tibble()) {
  path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(name, ".rds"))
  if (file.exists(path)) readRDS(path) else empty
}

stations <- read_snapshot("stations")
catches  <- read_snapshot("catches")
snapshot_date <- max(c(as.Date(NA), file.info(list.files(output_dir, full.names = TRUE))$mtime),
                     na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r summaries}
#| include: false
#| eval: false
# Derive every value the prose quotes. A cruise report is rewritten many times while data
# are still arriving, so nothing may be typed by hand.
```

## Software and reproducibility

This report was produced in `r R.version.string` [@rcoreteam], compiled with Quarto [@quarto] and rendered by knitr [@knitr]. Raw records and instrument files are read from the research vessel's servers by `R/1_data.R`; the report itself is rendered from structured local snapshots and can be reproduced without a server connection.

This document and the associated analyses were created with researcher-supervised generative AI (<!-- MODEL -->). The authors designed the survey, specified and checked the analyses, and reviewed, edited, and approved all AI-assisted content, for which they take full responsibility.
